correctness.rationale: All 553301 nonempty faces constructed and checked by a second induced-degree predicate. Both full oriented Hasse diagrams have 4268208 covering incidences and are acyclic by exhaustive topological sort. Residue-class matching critical cells (1 in dimension 0; 5,15,16 in dimensions 7,8,9) have integer Smith factors [] and [1]*14. Ascending matching critical cells (1; 7,21,20) have Smith factors [1]*2 and [1]*18. Both give free integral homology ranks (5,1,2), and their chain differentials square to zero. Euler characteristic -5 independently agrees. Reproducible standalone script and output included.

value.rationale: The unique (3,7)-cage is a canonical extremal cubic graph; its first higher-independence topology is a natural comparison with the established ordinary independence five-sphere. Three adjacent torsion-free integral groups constitute a nontrivial complete answer for this natural finite object and a reusable benchmark for higher-independence calculations, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
